minimum_target.name: Android API 26 emulator or physical phone
minimum_target.os_version: Android 8.0 or later baseline for Flutter/Media3 compatibility checks

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android System WebView/Chromium for embedded web content only; playback uses Media3/ExoPlayer.
storage_constraints: App-private storage for logs and offline package metadata
OS media/cache eviction can remove non-persistent cache data
Offline package storage must honor Phase 16c quota policy
known_limitations: Device codec APIs can overstate support; run the capability wizard before direct-play release claims.
Cleartext local HTTP is allowed only for local/VPN mode and must be disabled for exposed mode.

minimum_target.name: iOS simulator for sign-in and navigation

platforms.browser_webview_engine: WKWebView/WebKit for embedded web content only; playback uses AVFoundation/AVPlayer.
remote_input: Control Center media controls where applicable
storage_constraints: Keychain for bearer tokens
App container storage for logs and offline package metadata
Files marked cacheable may be purged by iOS
known_limitations: Local-network access needs platform permission text and manual LAN validation.
Simulator cannot prove hardware codec, HDR, AirPlay, or background media behavior.

platforms.browser_webview_engine: WebView2/Chromium for Tauri webview content; native media paths remain platform-specific when added.
storage_constraints: Windows Credential Locker or OS keyring for tokens
App data directory for selected server profiles and logs
Do not store signed URLs in plaintext files
known_limitations: Codec support depends on Windows edition, optional extensions, GPU, and installed media components.
VM smoke tests cannot prove HDR, HDMI audio, or hardware decoding.

minimum_target.name: Current macOS runner or development Mac
minimum_target.os_version: Current stable macOS release supported by Tauri

representative_targets.name: Intel Mac
representative_targets.os_version: Latest supported macOS for that hardware

storage_constraints: Keychain for tokens
Application Support directory for selected server profiles and logs
Notarized release builds must keep diagnostics export user-initiated
known_limitations: Intel and Apple silicon media capabilities differ; HDR and hardware decode need physical checks.
Local-network prompts must be tested outside CI.

minimum_target.name: Ubuntu LTS or equivalent desktop VM

platforms.browser_webview_engine: WebKitGTK/Wry stack for Tauri webview content where packaged.
storage_constraints: Secret Service/libsecret-compatible keyring where available
Fallback credential storage must be documented before release
Distro sandboxing can restrict filesystem diagnostics paths
known_limitations: Codec availability varies by distro packaging and patent policy.
Wayland/X11 focus and file-picker behavior must both be smoked when supported.

representative_targets.name: Chromecast with Google TV or equivalent Google TV device
Sony BRAVIA Google TV
representative_targets.os_version: Current supported Sony Google TV firmware

representative_targets.name: Sony BRAVIA Android TV
representative_targets.os_version: Supported older Sony Android TV firmware

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android WebView/Chromium only for web content; playback uses Media3/ExoPlayer.
storage_constraints: Limited app storage on TV devices
Avoid large diagnostics bundles
Offline downloads are not a first-release TV requirement
known_limitations: TV OEM codec support can differ from handheld Android despite similar APIs.
HDR and surround audio require physical HDMI/display-chain validation.

minimum_target.name: Fire TV device connected through ADB
minimum_target.os_version: Current Fire OS baseline supported by target app phase

representative_targets.name: Current Fire TV Stick 4K class device
Older Fire TV Stick class device

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android WebView/Chromium only for embedded content; playback uses Media3/ExoPlayer unless the platform phase selects another native player.
storage_constraints: Small app storage budgets on stick-class devices
Diagnostics bundles must stay capped and user-exported
ADB test installs must not require production signing secrets
known_limitations: Fire OS diverges from Google TV APIs and store requirements.
Catalog personalization and featured content may be partner or store-policy constrained.

minimum_target.name: Roku streaming player or Roku TV

representative_targets.name: Roku TV model
representative_targets.os_version: Current supported Roku OS for that model

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Not applicable; Roku uses SceneGraph/BrightScript runtime.
storage_constraints: Registry storage is small and must not hold bearer tokens in plaintext
Channel package size and runtime memory must stay within Roku certification expectations
Diagnostics export is platform-limited and may require on-screen code/manual copy
known_limitations: Codec, subtitle, and container support vary materially by Roku model generation.
Certification requires deep-link and Direct to Play behavior to be correct for media content.

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Samsung Tizen TV Web Runtime; playback uses AVPlay where available.
storage_constraints: Local storage quotas vary by model
Certificate profiles are required for real-device install
Diagnostics bundle should avoid filesystem assumptions
known_limitations: Emulator cannot prove AVPlay codec, DRM-free HLS, HDR, or HDMI audio behavior.
Model-year media specifications are release validation inputs.

platforms.browser_webview_engine: LG webOS TV Web Runtime; playback uses HTML media APIs and platform media options.
storage_constraints: App data storage is constrained by model and app lifecycle
Developer Mode installs expire and are not release evidence
Diagnostics export must be user-visible and bounded
known_limitations: Emulator cannot prove hardware decode, HDR, or audio output behavior.
Pointer and D-pad focus behavior both need manual validation.

platforms.browser_webview_engine: Not a web client; playback uses AVKit/AVFoundation.
storage_constraints: Small local storage budget
Keychain for auth material
No mobile-style offline download requirement for first TV release
known_limitations: Simulator cannot prove HDR, Dolby Vision, AirPlay, or HDMI audio.
Top Shelf and Universal Link behavior require signed builds and device validation.

minimum_target.name: Windows UWP local deployment before Xbox hardware

representative_targets.name: Xbox Series S or Series X
Xbox One S or One X
representative_targets.os_version: Current public Xbox OS for that generation

platforms.browser_webview_engine: UWP WebView2 only if used by the platform phase; media playback should use MediaPlayerElement/MediaPlayer.
storage_constraints: UWP app data sandbox
Credential Locker or platform credential API for tokens
Diagnostics export may require save/share broker flows
known_limitations: Original Xbox One should be treated as a reduced-capability profile.
